title: The Kindest Woman in Town
reflectionQuestion: Tabitha spent her whole life sewing warm clothes and caring for people in need. I wonder what kind thing you could do to help someone today?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, Acts 9:36-42; distinct from 1851 Paul/Acts 9:1). The gentle-kindness room + a beloved woman. WATCH-ITEM: death kept GENTLE ('became sick and... very gently, she died'); the raising is quiet + tender (Peter prays, 'Tabitha, get up', she opens her eyes). The HEART is a life of everyday kindness (sewing clothes for poor widows) and a community that loved her -> God's gentle restoration. Room = kindness matters / being loved / God's care. Tabitha=Dorcas (used Tabitha throughout). Soft close ('her'). VOICE_MARTHA_CARING (caring/domestic female -- ideal for the kind seamstress).
